steps.name: Keep the class balance
steps.purpose: Stratify the folds by the outcome.
steps.check: Each fold holds every class at its share
steps.rule: a fold without a class cannot score it

steps.name: Lock the holdout
steps.purpose: Set aside the rows the final score is read on, before any choice looks at the data.
steps.check: The holdout's rows are fixed and fingerprinted before any analysis or model

steps.name: Analyse the training rows
steps.purpose: Read the data for the decisions on the training rows only.
steps.check: Every finding about the target is computed on the training rows

steps.name: Audit leakage
steps.purpose: Check every column against the prediction moment before any model sees it.
steps.check: Each column kept is known at the prediction moment, each one dropped has its reason
steps.rule: a column written after the moment is never a feature

steps.name: Choose on validation
steps.purpose: Compare model families on the training rows' folds and choose.
steps.check: The choice is made on folds of the training rows, with each score's spread

steps.name: Choose the operating point
steps.purpose: Pick the threshold from what an alert costs, on validation folds.
steps.check: The threshold is chosen on the training rows' folds

steps.name: The holdout gate
steps.purpose: A person signs that the solution is final before the holdout is read.
steps.check: The approval is recorded before the final score
steps.rule: a person decides when the holdout is spent

steps.name: Score the holdout once
steps.purpose: Read the holdout once, with an interval.
steps.check: The holdout is read once; a second read needs a person's reason and is flagged

steps.name: Report with limits
steps.purpose: Say the score with its uncertainty and what it does not show.
steps.check: Every number traces to its record; never called production-ready from benchmark evidence
steps.rule: report results with uncertainty and limits
